label: PF Backlog 573
title: Worker charter: add guideline 15 (reuse & simplicity; self-review the diff for dead code / duplicate logic / unused components before completing)
body:
## Goal
Codify the post-implementation clean-up discipline in the worker charter so every worker removes unneeded dead code / duplicate logic / unused components / redundant complexity that IT added, while keeping what the feature needs.

## Change
workergrid/instructions.md: add guideline 15 (design-time reuse-first + before-completing diff self-review) and one line each in Full lifecycle (design) + Definition of Done.

## Acceptance
Guideline 15 present; lifecycle + DoD reference it.
